title: Company details
description: Schema for company-profile/<company_id>/details.json, the canonical profile of one regulated entity: legal identity, licences, regulatory categorisation, frameworks in scope, key contacts, critical functions and risk appetite. Every workflow reads this file first to decide which instruments apply

examples.description: Discount broking and depository participant serving retail investors across India via mobile and web trading platforms

criticalFunctions.name: Order routing to exchanges
criticalFunctions.description: Acceptance, validation and routing of client orders to NSE and BSE during market hours

riskAppetite.statement: Zero tolerance for client data breaches or unapproved trading downtime during market hours; medium residual risk accepted for internal tooling

companyId.description: Slug identifying the company; must equal the company-profile/<company_id> folder name

legalName.description: Registered legal name exactly as it appears on the certificate of incorporation or licence

brandName.description: Trading or brand name used publicly when it differs from the legal name

description.description: One-paragraph plain-language summary of what the company does and whom it serves

state.description: State or province of the registered office

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the registered office

jurisdictions.description: Every jurisdiction in which the company is licensed or supervised, exactly one of them marked primary. Drives which regulators' instruments are considered applicable

entityTypes.description: Regulated-entity licence categories the company holds, from the closed entity-types vocabulary. At least one is needed to select applicable instruments

regulatoryRegistrations.description: Licences and registrations with regulators, including the regulator's cyber-resilience categorisation (SEBI CSCRF RE category, RBI UCB tier or cyber level, NBFC scale-based layer). At least one is required unless entityTypes holds only fintech-unregulated or technology-service-provider

frameworksInScope.description: Regulatory instruments and frameworks the company is assessed against. Findings, risks and initiatives cite controls from these instruments first

contacts.description: Named accountable persons by governance role. Workflows route approvals, incident reports (designated-officer), grievances (grievance-officer) and audit evidence requests to these contacts

orgSize.description: Headcount figures used to scale expectations such as SOC model and audit cadence

techHeadcount.description: Employees in engineering, IT and data roles

securityHeadcount.description: Employees dedicated to information security, including SOC analysts

fiscalYearStart.description: First day of the fiscal year as MM-DD; Indian entities use 04-01

dataResidency.description: Countries in which regulated data may be stored at rest. Indian payment and SPDI data is normally restricted to IN

criticalFunctions.description: Critical or important business services in the DORA and SEBI CSCRF sense, with impact tolerances. Vendors and applications reference these by functionId, which must be unique within the array (checked by validate-data, not by uniqueItems)

riskAppetite.description: Board-approved risk appetite used to decide which findings may be risk-accepted

statement.description: Risk appetite statement in the board's own words

maxAcceptableSeverity.description: Highest finding severity that may be risk-accepted without board escalation

socModel.description: How security monitoring is delivered: in-house SOC, a managed SOC provider, the SEBI Market SOC operated by NSE/BSE for small REs, or none

auditCadence.description: Mandated frequency of independent security assessments and when they last happened

vaptPerYear.description: Vulnerability assessment and penetration tests required per fiscal year

cyberAuditPerYear.description: Cyber security or IT audits by a CERT-In empanelled or regulator-approved auditor required per fiscal year

lastVaptAt.description: Date the most recent VAPT report was issued

lastCyberAuditAt.description: Date the most recent cyber audit report was issued

tags.description: Free-form lowercase labels for filtering companies

identifiers.description: Statutory and market identifiers. Keys are closed; leave out any the company does not hold

llpin.description: MCA LLP Identification Number for limited liability partnerships

tan.description: Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number

gstin.description: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number of the principal place of business

sebiRegistrationNos.description: All SEBI registration numbers held (broker INZ, DP IN-DP, IA INA, RA INH, PMS INP, AMC, AIF and so on)

rbiCorNo.description: RBI Certificate of Registration number for NBFCs, HFCs, PSOs and PPI issuers

irdaiRegistrationNo.description: IRDAI registration number for insurers and intermediaries

ifscaRegistrationNo.description: IFSCA registration number for GIFT City entities

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the supervising jurisdiction

state.description: State, province or special zone (for example Maharashtra, GIFT City) when supervision is sub-national

primary.description: True for the home jurisdiction whose instruments take precedence

registrationNo.description: Registration or licence number as issued by the regulator

category.description: Regulator's cyber-resilience or supervisory categorisation, from the shared reCategory vocabulary (also used by catalog/instruments applicability.categories)

categorisedAt.description: Date the current category was assigned; SEBI CSCRF categorisation is re-assessed each fiscal year

validUntil.description: Expiry date for time-limited registrations; omit for perpetual ones

status.description: Current standing of the registration with the regulator

contactRole.description: Alias of common contactRole, kept so existing $refs to details.schema.json#/$defs/contactRole keep resolving

role.description: Governance role the person fills; one person may appear under several roles

phone.description: E.164 phone number with country code, digits only after the plus sign

functionId.description: Slug referenced by vendor services (criticalFunctionRefs) and applications

description.description: What the service does and why its disruption matters to clients or markets

impactTolerance.description: Maximum tolerable disruption, expressed as recovery-time and recovery-point objectives

maxOutageMinutes.description: Recovery time objective in minutes; SEBI CSCRF expects 30 minutes for critical systems of MIIs

maxDataLossMinutes.description: Recovery point objective in minutes; 0 means no data loss is tolerable
